IBM, AMD, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory partners have announced a new quantum error‑correction platform designed to improve the reliability of emerging quantum processors. The initiative focuses on developing advanced algorithms and hardware techniques to detect and correct quantum errors in real time, aiming to bring larger-scale, fault‑tolerant quantum systems closer to practical deployment. This collaboration represents a significant step toward scalable, resilient quantum computing.
